intro: Bottles and Baubles is a quest built around the quirky logic that because murlocs look like fish, they must think like them. Adventurers are sent to rummage through a nearby murloc camp for glittering junk and discarded trinkets that an eager angler can fashion into fishing bait.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!
If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What did you find? Anything interesting?

clips.title: Completion
paras: An interesting collection. These should work well enough!
Here's some of my own older supplies. It should help anyone trying to get their footing in fishing.
